messages:
Renee (PM): Heads-up: Meridian wants private pilot with HSM + p95 SLA. Staging target = EoQ.
Omar (Runtime): HSM + strict p95 in private infra doable but needs KV caching + quant checks. Need infra slot.
Lydia (Infra): We have one spare prewarm slot but it's allocated to Beacon. Can reassign if Beacon agrees to delay.
Renee (PM): Meridian will accept a staged canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) if we provide clear gating.
Sam (Security): HSM integration needs attestation + short pen test. Timeline: ~10 business days for attestation/config and ~4 days for pen test after infra is live. Key policy must be signed pre-prod.
Omar (Runtime): I'll own the rollout playbook and include fallback to hosted variant. Need tracing and token-level telemetry for canary, plus a small prompt set for quality checks.
Lydia (Infra): If we transfer the prewarm slot, infra (VPC peering, routing, NAT) can be ready in ~7 days. Need sign-off by EOD Tue.
Renee (PM): Proposed gating: (1) HSM attestation complete, (2) pen test no critical issues, (3) canary metrics: error_rate <0.5% and p95 within SLA for 48h.
Omar (Runtime): Canary snippet I'll use: ```yaml
canary:
  - percent: 10
    duration: 48h
  - percent: 50
    duration: 72h
rollback_on:
  - error_rate_pct: 0.5
  - p95_latency_delta_pct: 15
```
ops-bot: Reminder: add "Meridian private pilot" to launch-lane board: /boards/launch-lane/Meridian-private-pilot.
Renee (PM): Action items: (1) Renee -> negotiate slot transfer with Beacon by EOD Tue; (2) Lydia -> prep infra template after confirmation; (3) Omar -> draft playbook + telemetry hooks by next Wed; (4) Sam -> schedule attestation/pen test. Flagging as customer-driven high priority. :thumbsup:
